title: Exponential and Logarithmic Functions: e, Logs, Equations, Growth | Algebra II, Unit 8
description:
Model with exponentials, meet the number e and continuous growth, define logarithms as inverses, use log properties, solve exponential and logarithmic equations, graph logs, and apply compound interest and half-life. Each section ends with a practice problem.
